rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Senate Bill 63, the Youth Online Safety Act, a bill to bar online platforms using minors' data to pick their content and ads. The Nevada Senate passed it 13-8, but the Senate never voted on the Assembly's changed version, so it never became law.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Senate Bill 63, the Youth Online Safety Act, a bill to bar online platforms using minors' data to pick their content and ads. The Nevada Senate passed it 13-8, but the Senate never voted on the Assembly's changed version, so it never became law.
